objective: reject wrong-source reference associations before any model-quality measurement
inputs: card IDs, titles, URLs, snippets, caller purpose and facet definitions; never model ranks/scores/actions
facet_anchor_requirement: every tagged facet has at least one exact substring anchor in the same supplied card
inventory: exactly every supplied card once; valid declared facet IDs only; no unknown/missing/duplicate IDs or keys
hash: SHA256 of UTF8 json of exact id/title/url/snippet with sorted keys and compact separators
normalization: strip validation-only binding/anchor metadata into unchanged legacy metric fields; no inferred grades or tags
semantic_boundary: hashes and substrings prove source association, not correctness/relevance; independently inspect every source/rationale/grade/facet before sealing
registered_fixtures: hash stable under object key order
validation metadata removed without grade changes
decision: all finite valid/rejecting fixtures pass and independent review resolves blocking findings; no ranking or adoption claim
